name: Eko CORE 500 Digital Stethoscope (Silver)
seoTitle: Eko CORE 500 Digital Stethoscope Gift Guide
metaDescription: The CORE 500 digital stethoscope with a color display and Eko app support. A major milestone gift for an NP, ICU nurse, or advanced practice grad.
summary: A premium digital stethoscope for a nurse who loves tech and has a real clinical use for it, best saved for a big milestone like NP graduation.
whyItWorks: Most stethoscope gifts are classic acoustic models. The CORE 500 sits in a different category, with amplification, noise cancellation, a full color display, and ECG features listed in the title, plus pairing with the Eko app. That makes it a gift for a specific person: a nurse practitioner, a cardiac or ICU nurse, or a new advanced practice grad who will actually use digital features day to day.

Because it is a serious investment, it works best as a once in a career gift, the kind a family pools together for a master's graduation or a board certification. Before buying, it is smart to quietly ask what the recipient's employer allows and whether they already prefer a certain brand, since clinicians often have strong opinions about the tools they wear around their neck every shift. If you are unsure, a gift card toward it can be a respectful alternative that still feels generous.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for what the Eko app subscription includes and whether any features require a paid plan.
A bedside nurse who rarely auscultates may get more from a quality acoustic stethoscope.
Confirm charging needs and what comes in the box on the listing before gifting.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Usually not. Students do well with a solid acoustic stethoscope, and this one makes more sense for an NP or experienced clinician.

faq.q: Can it be engraved or personalized?
faq.a: The title does not mention personalization, so check the listing or plan a separate personalized ID tag.
